question: The joint exercise involving the Indian Army's Kharga Corps and the Indian Air Force in 2024 was conducted in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **joint exercise between the Indian Army's Kharga Corps and the Indian Air Force (IAF) in 2024 was conducted in Punjab**.
 
• The exercise **was named "Gagan Strike-II".**
 
• The exercise was designed to validate the use of attack helicopters in mechanized operations. 
 
• It **also aimed to improve operational preparedness and the use of assets to support ground offensive campaigns. **
 
• The exercise involved live firing by helicopters, practicing attack helicopter missions, and engaging targets in the battlefield​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __Indian Airforce:__

__
 
• It was established in October 1932.
 
• It is one of the parts of the Indian Armed forces, the others being the Indian Army and Indian Navy.
 
• The President of India is the Supreme Commander of the IAF.
 
• The Indian Airforce is the Fourth__ largest Airforce in the world in terms of both personnel and aircraft.
 
• Arjan Singh was the first five-star rank-holding officer in IAF.
 
• Subroto Mukherjee was the first Chief of the Air Staff of the Indian Airforce.
 
• Subroto Mukherjee is also known as the Father of the Indian Air Force.
